title: Multi-Head Cross-Attention
hint: Q from decoder (x_q), K/V from encoder (x_kv). Project, reshape to multi-head, compute scaled dot-product attention (no causal mask). Concat heads and project output.

description.text: Implement multi-head cross-attention for encoder–decoder models: queries from the decoder sequence, keys and values from the encoder. Use Q/K/V projections, scaled dot-product attention without a causal mask, then an output projection—typical of transformer decoders.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
